source.book: KET青少版官方真题2（扫描版）

parts.1:
Test Two. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
Question 1
One. What’s the subject of the girl’s geography project?
Girl: Isn’t your geography project about forests?
Boy: It’s only about one forest in South America. What’s yours about?
Girl: Well, first I wanted to do something about oceans, but then I decided to do it on some of the largest deserts in the world.
Boy: Cool. I think it’s amazing that plants and animals can live in places that have very little water.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2
Two. Where do the two friends decide to go first?
Nathan: Hey Janine. Are you on your way to the cafeteria? They’re serving that really good pasta dish today!
Janine: Oh, hey Nathan. Yeah, but first I have to pick up a book from the library. I need it before the next lesson.
Nathan: You mean for our chemistry class that’s after lunch? Then let’s go get it, so we can have lunch together.
Janine: Sure.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3
Three. Why has the girl come home late?
Man: Jessica, why are you home so late? Isn’t basketball practice tomorrow after school?
Girl: That’s right, Dad. I had to stay after class to talk to Mrs Patterson about part of the history homework that I didn’t really understand.
Man: Oh, that’s alright then.
Girl: Great. So now I need to call my classmates to give them the information.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4
Four. Where has the boy already found some useful information about elephants?
Woman: Jonathan, what are you doing on the internet?
Boy: I’m doing my homework, Mum. I’m looking for some information about elephants, but I haven’t found anything I can use yet. Grandpa gave me a magazine with an article with some interesting facts, but that’s all.
Woman: Well, we’ve got lots of books about animals. Have you checked any of those?
Boy: I’ll do that next.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5
Five. What will the girl do for her friend’s birthday party?
Man: You’re going to Jessie’s birthday party soon, aren’t you?
Girl: Yeah, she doesn’t want anyone to give her gifts this year, Dad. Instead, she wants her friends to do different things for her party. I’ve got to take photos of everyone for her blog.
Man: Will someone bake her a cake?
Girl: Yes, I think so. And someone else is going to play the guitar.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher telling a group of students about a tour of a sports stadium.
Man: OK, class. Before we go inside the stadium, I just need to give you some information.
Your tour today is starting from the café. It’s just over there next to this entrance.
Your tour guide’s name is Jacob Jackster, that’s spelled J-A-C-K-S-T-E-R. He’ll be happy to answer questions today, or later by email, so write that down.
Different members of staff wear different colour T-shirts. Your guide will always be easy to see because his is yellow. All other members of staff wear a red T-shirt.
Your tour starts in 15 minutes and it will take 45 minutes, so I’ll meet you back here in one hour. OK?
At the end of the tour you’ll each get a present. It’s a scarf. You can also buy things like a cap or a mug in the gift shop later.
After the tour, I’ll take you to a special exhibition, where you can see drawings. These are by one of the club’s players, who is also a great artist.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear a girl, Miriam, asking for information about jazz dance classes at a dance school.
Miriam: Hello, can I join your jazz dance class?
Man: We finish term soon but there’s a holiday course. It begins on Monday 15th. The weekend courses are full I’m afraid.
Miriam: OK. That’s alright.
Man: Have you danced before?
Miriam: I’m advanced level in modern and I’ve got a bit of experience doing hip hop. I wanted to do disco, but I never found a class.
Man: That’s fine.
Miriam: Is there anything I should or shouldn’t wear to class?
Man: Your normal trainers are fine. But earrings or bracelets are dangerous, so leave them at home. You’ll get a sweater with the school name on it when you join.
Miriam: What happens in class?
Man: Everybody dances together. Sometimes we’ll film you to help you improve. There’s lots of famous songs to dance to, and students decide which ones to use.
Miriam: Great!
Man: So why do you want to learn jazz?
Miriam: I know the school does jazz dance competitions – I’m not interested in that, but I’d like to take part in your shows. And someone told me the jazz teachers here are good!
Man: That’s nice.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16
Sixteen. You will hear two friends talking about their holiday plans. What does the girl hope to do this summer?
Boy: What are your plans for the summer? I’m going to New York!
Girl: I’d love to go there! And I probably will ’cos my aunt’s going to move there next year. We’re going to Spain again. Dad’s promised I can have riding lessons. That’ll be fantastic! I’ve always dreamt of doing that. It’s a pity Grandpa’s not coming with us this summer.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17
Seventeen. You will hear a teacher talking to her class. Where does she want them to go now?
Teacher: OK, I know I said we’d go to the library now but it’s such a lovely day that it’s better to be outside. You can sit on the grass and read your books. We’ll have to come back when Class 3 go there for football practice. But before coming back to the classroom you can get a drink from the café.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18
Eighteen. You will hear two friends talking in a café. What’s the problem with their food?
Boy: Are you enjoying this pizza?
Girl: Actually, I think it’s disgusting.
Boy: I don’t like it either. It’s really dry. I think they forgot when it was time to take it out of the oven. I’m sorry now that I didn’t choose the salad instead.
Girl: Me too. But at least it wasn’t expensive.
Boy: That’s true.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19
Nineteen. You will hear a girl leaving a message for a friend. Why is she going to be late?
Girl: Hi Josh. Sorry, I’ll be a bit late for our tennis class. Mum’s just called to tell me to go home after school. She can’t get off work but the woman who lives next door has lost her keys and can’t get in. We’ve got an extra set of keys at home. I’ve got to find them and let her in.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20
Twenty. You will hear a brother and sister talking about a picnic. What do they still need to do?
Boy: Hi Janet, have we got everything we need for the picnic?
Girl: Almost. I’ve got some bottles of sparkling water and all the things for the sandwiches - the rolls and the cheese were on special offer.
Boy: Great! Do you want to play volleyball before we eat?
Girl: Sure! But where’s the net? Oh, and the ball?
Boy: I think they’re in the garage.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear Sara and Jason talking about a meeting after school to make a poster for a project. What will each person bring to the meeting?
Sara: Hi Jason, everyone in our group’s bringing something for the meeting tomorrow.
Jason: Yes, to make a good poster, we’ll need some big pieces of paper, and I can bring that. My dad ordered some from an art magazine.
Sara: Great! And Paul?
Jason: His computer isn’t working but he’s got lots of paints that we can all use.
Sara: And Anna reads lots of magazines and they’ve got lots of adverts for snacks and things in them, so I’m sure we’ll find some great ideas for our poster about food so she’s bringing those.
Jason: What’s Tom bringing?
Sara: He wanted to bring his mum’s camera but it’s a very expensive one, so he can only bring his laptop, but that’ll be useful.
Jason: And Jenny’s got some orange juice – enough for us all! But we mustn’t take snacks to school. That’s a pity! And what are you bringing, Sara?
Sara: We’ll need some scissors, and we’ve got several pairs at home. Remember, I brought them to school before when we had to do a painting of something from home?
Jason: Oh yeah – great!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 女孩说 "first I wanted to do something about oceans"，但 "then I decided to do it on some of the largest deserts in the world"，起初想研究海洋，后来决定研究世界上一些最大的沙漠，因此选择 B。
explanations.p1q2: Nathan 问 Janine "Are you on your way to the cafeteria?"，先提到餐厅；但 Janine 说 "but first I have to pick up a book from the library"，要先去图书馆拿书，因此选择 A；两人午饭后才有化学课（"our chemistry class that’s after lunch"），所以第一站是图书馆。
explanations.p1q3: 爸爸问 "Isn’t basketball practice tomorrow after school?"，篮球训练是明天；女孩说今天 "I had to stay after class to talk to Mrs Patterson about part of the history homework"，放学后留下来向老师请教历史作业，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q4: 男孩正在网上找大象资料，但 "I haven’t found anything I can use yet"；妈妈提到家里的书，男孩说 "I’ll do that next"，书也还没查；只有 "Grandpa gave me a magazine with an article with some interesting facts"，爷爷给的杂志文章已经提供了一些资料，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q5: 女孩说 "I’ve got to take photos of everyone for her blog."，她负责为博客拍所有人的照片；蛋糕有人做（"Will someone bake her a cake?"），吉他也有人弹（"someone else is going to play the guitar"），因此选择 A。
explanations.p2q1: 老师说 "Your tour guide’s name is Jacob Jackster, that’s spelled J-A-C-K-S-T-E-R."，导游名叫 Jacob Jackster，因此填姓 Jackster；老师还逐字母拼出了拼写，注意不要漏写或多写字母。
explanations.p2q2: 老师说 "Your guide will always be easy to see because his is yellow."，导游的 T 恤是黄色的，因此填 yellow；其他工作人员穿的是 "a red T-shirt"，不要误填 red。
explanations.p2q3: 老师说 "Your tour starts in 15 minutes and it will take 45 minutes"，参观本身用时 45 分钟，因此填 45；15 分钟是出发前的等待时间，"so I’ll meet you back here in one hour" 的一小时是回到集合点的总时长，都不要误填。
explanations.p2q4: 老师说 "At the end of the tour you’ll each get a present. It’s a scarf."，参观结束时每人免费得到的礼物是围巾，因此填 scarf；帽子或杯子是之后在礼品店花钱买的（"You can also buy things like a cap or a mug in the gift shop later."），不是免费礼物。
explanations.p2q5: 老师说参观后会带大家去特别展览 "where you can see drawings"，展出的艺术作品是绘画，因此填 drawings；这些作品出自 "one of the club’s players, who is also a great artist"，即俱乐部一名同时也是出色画家的球员。
explanations.p3q1: 男士说 "We finish term soon but there’s a holiday course"，学期即将结束，好在有假期课程，且 "It begins on Monday 15th"，Miriam 能参加的是从 15 日周一开始的假期课程，因此选择 A（during the holiday）；周末课程已满（"The weekend courses are full I’m afraid"），新学期还没开始。
explanations.p3q2: Miriam 说 "I’m advanced level in modern"，现代舞已达高级水平，因此选择 B；嘻哈只是 "a bit of experience doing hip hop"，略有经验；迪斯科则 "I wanted to do disco, but I never found a class"，想学但没找到班。
explanations.p3q3: 男士说 "Your normal trainers are fine"，运动鞋可以照常穿，入学时还会收到毛衣（"You’ll get a sweater with the school name on it when you join"）；而 "earrings or bracelets are dangerous, so leave them at home"，耳环和手镯这类首饰有危险，应留在家里，因此选择 B（jewellery）。
explanations.p3q4: 男士说课上 "students decide which ones to use"，由学生决定使用哪些歌曲跳舞，因此选择 A；"Sometimes we’ll film you to help you improve" 指有时拍摄学生本人来帮助进步，并不是观看著名舞者的视频，也没有提到要与搭档合作。
explanations.p3q5: Miriam 说 "I’m not interested in that, but I’d like to take part in your shows"，她明确说对比赛不感兴趣，想参加学校演出，因此选择 C（to be in shows）。
explanations.p4q1: 女孩说 "We’re going to Spain again"，会再次去西班牙，并没有去新国家；爸爸答应 "I can have riding lessons"，她一直梦想学骑马（"I’ve always dreamt of doing that"），因此选择 C（learn a new sport）；姑姑是明年才搬去纽约，她并不是去住在亲戚家。
explanations.p4q2: 老师说 "I know I said we’d go to the library now but it’s such a lovely day that it’s better to be outside"，原本计划去图书馆，因天气好改为去外面，让大家 "You can sit on the grass and read your books"，即去公园，因此选择 C；咖啡馆是返回教室前才去（"you can get a drink from the café"）。
explanations.p4q3: 男孩说披萨 "It’s really dry"，很干，并认为 "I think they forgot when it was time to take it out of the oven"，店员忘了及时把它从烤箱拿出来，是做得不好，因此选择 C；女孩说 "at least it wasn’t expensive"，它并不贵。
explanations.p4q4: 女孩说妈妈叫她放学后回家，因为 "the woman who lives next door has lost her keys and can’t get in"，她得 "find them and let her in"，要帮助的是住在隔壁丢了钥匙进不了门的女士，这是邻居，不是家人或同学，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q5: 女孩说 "I’ve got some bottles of sparkling water and all the things for the sandwiches"，饮料和食物都已备好；但排球网和球还没找到（"But where’s the net? Oh, and the ball?"），男孩说 "I think they’re in the garage"，还要去车库找运动器材，因此选择 B。
explanations.p5q1: Jason 说 "His computer isn’t working but he’s got lots of paints that we can all use."，Paul 的电脑坏了不能带，带来的是大家可以共用的颜料，因此选 E（paints）。
explanations.p5q2: Sara 说 "Anna reads lots of magazines and they’ve got lots of adverts for snacks and things in them, so I’m sure we’ll find some great ideas for our poster about food so she’s bringing those."，Anna 带来的是她那些登满广告的杂志，因此选 D（magazines）；snacks 只是杂志广告里的内容，而且学校不许带零食。
explanations.p5q3: Sara 说 Tom 本想带妈妈的相机，"but it’s a very expensive one, so he can only bring his laptop"，相机太贵没带成，只能带笔记本电脑，laptop 即 computer，因此选 B（computer）；camera 是干扰项。
explanations.p5q4: Jason 说 "Jenny’s got some orange juice – enough for us all!"，Jenny 带的橙汁属于饮品，因此选 C（drinks）；零食不能带去学校（"we mustn’t take snacks to school"），所以 H 不对。
explanations.p5q5: Sara 说 "We’ll need some scissors, and we’ve got several pairs at home."，她带家里备有的几把剪刀，因此选 G（scissors）；纸是 Jason 爸爸订好的，由 Jason 带来。
